title: Async function ends code without error when called on a resource without await
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.6 dev6 and 4.5 stable
- no other versions tested

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev6 - Windows 10 (build 19045)

### Issue description

In Godot there's an issue where calling an async function within a resource without `await` will cause the code within the resource to stop without any reason. The function never finishes nor is an error message logged.

example code:

`main.gd`
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var resource_instance=preload("res://test_resource.gd").new()
	
	#attermpting to call an async function inside a resource without await
	resource_instance.getData() #adding await to the start of this line will allow the code to complete
```

`test_resource.gd`
```gdscript
func getData():
	var data=await Autoload.wait()
	print(data)
```

`autoload.gd`
```gdscript
func wait():
	await get_tree().create_timer(0).timeout
	return "this is the requested data"
```

The code in `_ready` will complete, but the `print(data)` will never actually run because the code in the resource will end at `var data=await Autoload.wait()`.

Thanks in advance for your help!

### Steps to reproduce

Download the MRP, open it in Godot (ideally 4.6 dev6), and press the run button. The script that starts it is `main.gd`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[async_resource_function_MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24067869/async_resource_function_MRP.zip)
